# Design decisions

<!-- docsync:auto:begin - generated by docsync, edits inside this block are overwritten -->
> **Section status: CURRENT** - reviewed 2026-11-20; not tied to specific files, so it never goes stale.
<!-- docsync:auto:end -->

<!-- The "why" log. One entry per decision, newest first. Include decisions that were reversed. -->

## 2026-11-17 — Send each file in the form the model accepts
- **Context:** models were handed empty transcripts or OCR text as if it were pasted. Non-audio models answered that "no file was attached".
- **Decision:**
  - attachments travel as references (`{"type": "attachment", "upload_id"}`);
  - per model and API, each kind is sent natively, or converted (OCR with `mistral-ocr-latest`, transcript with `voxtral-mini-latest`, or a description when there is no speech);
  - converted files are introduced as an attached file;
  - the choice is driven by measured model support, with one retry as text if a model refuses.
- **Alternatives rejected:** always converting to text, which loses images and audio for capable models; sending everything natively, which is refused by many models.
- **Consequences:** `services/attachments.py` owns the support matrix; the playground, agent chat and workflow inputs all use it; stored conversations never hold file bytes.
- **Code:** `backend/app/services/attachments.py`, `routes/uploads.py`, `frontend-3/src/components/chat/*`.

## 2026-11-16 — Default decision model is mistral-medium-2604, with hedging and a breaker
- **Context:** planning with `mistral-large-4` was about 10 times slower, with the same correctness (measured).
- **Decision:** every role routes to `mistral-medium-2604`, with fallback `mistral-large-4`, a 45 s hedge, and a rate-limit breaker. Agent steps hedge to `AGENT_FALLBACK_MODEL` after 40 s.
- **Alternatives rejected:** large-4 everywhere (too slow); `mistral-small-2603` (kept as `LIGHT` but unused).
- **Consequences:** routes are overridable per role (`ROUTE_<ROLE>_*`, the Settings page). Fallback must differ from primary (`other_model`). The rejected-effort error strings are detected verbatim.
- **Code:** `backend/app/llm_routes.py`, `core/decision.py`, `services/workflow_engine/agent_call.py`.

## 2026-11-16 — A workflow is "complete" only when verified
- **Context:** unverified workflows were reported as done, then failed on their first run.
- **Decision:** planning runs scenario design and a dry run (`WORKFLOW_DRY_RUN`, 3 scenarios, up to 2 repairs). A repair is kept only if it does not make the result worse. The result carries `verified` or `not_verified_reason`.
- **Consequences:** plans take longer. Transient failures get `WORKFLOW_DRY_RUN_TRANSIENT_RETRIES` (2).
- **Code:** `layers/workflow/verify_layers.py`, `services/workflow_engine/dry_run.py`.

## 2026-11-15 — Staged pipelines with a data contract, rewind and self-repair
- **Context:** single long prompts produced inconsistent plans that were hard to fix.
- **Decision:**
  - one focused decision per layer, grouped into named stages;
  - a data contract layer fixes the inputs and outputs before the design;
  - validation issues rewind to the layer that owns them (`issue_owners`);
  - user decisions get countdowns with a recommended default.
- **Alternatives rejected:** a single planner prompt; LangGraph-style frameworks (not used anywhere).
- **Consequences:** a layer added to the backend appears in the UI timeline with no frontend change. Exact stage labels are user-visible.
- **Code:** `backend/app/core/*`, `backend/app/layers/__init__.py`, `layers/workflow/*`.

## 2026-11-14 — Keep credentials out of Mistral traces
- **Context:** tracing exported request bodies to Mistral observability.
- **Decision:** sign-in and admin requests are never exported; attributes are redacted (`OBSERVABILITY_REDACT`) and capped (`OBSERVABILITY_MAX_ATTR_CHARS` 16000); vault values are scrubbed from results.
- **Code:** `backend/app/observability/*`, `vault/redact.py`.

## 2026-11-07 — Local accounts with workspaces = Mistral keys, and a separate admin console
- **Context:** the platform was single-user, on one key.
- **Decision:**
  - local argon2 accounts with httpOnly cookie sessions;
  - each workspace is one Mistral API key, encrypted with the vault master keys;
  - users have memberships with roles;
  - platform admins are a separate table and console with no workspace permissions;
  - a deny-by-default route policy is shared with the browser;
  - data is scoped by an automatic ORM filter on `workspace_id`.
- **Alternatives rejected:** an external IdP or SSO (not needed for the deployment); per-tenant databases.
- **Consequences:**
  - every new route needs a policy rule;
  - every new workspace-owned model must be registered in `auth/setup.py`;
  - one worker process per workspace;
  - some tables remain platform-wide (see the known issues).
- **Code:** `backend/app/auth/*`, `routes/auth.py`, `routes/admin.py`, `frontend-3/src/routes/admin.*`, `lib/policy.tsx`.

## 2026-11-02 — Simplify the ontology into a catalog, and add best-practice knowledge
- **Context:** the SKOS-style ontology UI was too complex for users.
- **Decision:**
  - present it as the "Catalog";
  - keep every knowledge-graph capability intact (the change was additive only);
  - move build guidance into knowledge items with conditions and approval.
- **Consequences:** `app/ontology/*` and `app/process_knowledge/*` remain as legacy alias modules; the URLs still say `/ontology`.
- **Code:** `backend/app/catalog/*`, `backend/app/knowledge/*`.

## Undated (before 2026-11-14) — Synthesis as jobs, not a blocking call
- **Context:** the old blocking `POST /synthesize` gave up after 180 s while the service carried on, so a tool could appear after the planner had recorded the build as failed.
- **Decision:** `POST /synthesis/jobs` with SSE events and polling; jobs are deduplicated by spec hash.
- **Consequences:** `SYNTHESIZE_WAIT_SECONDS` exists for the legacy endpoint; the backend awaits for up to 1200 s.
- **Code:** `tool-service/app/synthesis/jobs.py`, `backend/app/services/tool_resolver.py`.

## Undated (before 2026-11-16) — Codestral excluded from code-writing roles
- **Context:** code-writing roles produced lower-quality specs and code with Codestral. The original README describes Codestral as the generator.
- **Decision:** a guard in both services rewrites any configured `codestral*` model on a code role back to the base model.
- **Code:** `backend/app/llm_routes.py` (`EXCLUDED_CODE_MODELS`), `tool-service/app/llm/routes.py`.

## 2026-10-05 — Single-VM Docker deployment behind Caddy
- **Decision:** one compose stack (Caddy, frontend, backend, tool-service, neo4j) on a VM (Azure script). Only Caddy is published; the Tool Service and Neo4j are internal. SQLite on volumes.
- **Alternatives rejected:** Kubernetes, managed databases (not needed at this scale).
- **Consequences:** SQLite concurrency limits; the backend writes compiled workflows into the repo checkout mounted as a volume.
- **Code:** `deploy/*`, `DEPLOYMENT.md`.

## 2026-09-10 — Replace the Vite SPA with frontend-3 (TanStack Start, generated from a Lovable template)
- **Decision:** a new frontend with file-based routes, SSR (Nitro), shadcn/ui and a token-based theme. The old `frontend/` is kept for reference.
- **Consequences:** the Lovable Vite config must not be given duplicate plugins; the dev port is 8080; the README is outdated.
- **Code:** `frontend-3/*`.

## 2026-07-06 — Layered pipeline architecture
- **Decision:** move from monolithic orchestrator functions to `core.Pipeline` with layers and SSE events.
- **Code:** `backend/app/core/*`, `backend/app/layers/*`.

## 2026-05 — Hybrid execution: local DAG engine plus Mistral Workflows
- **Decision:** every workflow can run locally (always available) and, once published, on Mistral Workflows through a compiled module. Both executors share `step_runners.run_step`, so behaviour matches.
- **Consequences:** step runners must work without request context; the worker runs as a separate process per key.
- **Code:** `services/workflow_engine/*`, `services/mistral_workflows_compiler.py`, `services/mistral_worker.py`.
